public.title: Reverse Linked List
public.description: A singly linked list is serialized as its values from head to tail. Return the values of the list after reversing its links. The array has 0 to 1000 integers from -10000 to 10000. This value-only JSON adaptation does not test pointer identity or in-place mutation.
hints: The last node becomes the new head.
Visit serialized values from right to left.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Read serialized nodes backward to produce the reversed list. O(n) time and O(n) output space. Pointer identity is outside this JSON contract.
